mission: Apart is a nonprofit that researches and evaluates manipulation risks in frontier AI, and brings new people into AI safety through weekend research hackathons (Sprints) and fellowships. It offers evaluations and evidence to AI labs and policymakers.

key_work.title: DarkBench: Benchmarking Dark Patterns in Large Language Models
key_work.plain_summary: Tests chatbots for manipulative 'dark patterns' such as sycophancy, brand bias and keeping users hooked (ICLR 2025 oral).

key_work.title: Noise Injection Reveals Hidden Capabilities of Sandbagging Language Models
key_work.plain_summary: Adding noise to a model's weights can expose capabilities a model is deliberately hiding on tests.

key_work.title: Multi-Agent Risks from Advanced AI (Cooperative AI Foundation report)
key_work.plain_summary: Maps the new risks that appear when many AI agents interact: miscoordination, conflict and collusion.

key_work.title: Apart Sprints
key_work.plain_summary: Weekend research hackathons on a single AI safety question, open to anyone, online and at local sites.

warnings.text: Frontier AI systems can manipulate users.
Models may sandbag (hide capabilities) during evaluations.
Interacting AI agents create new kinds of risk.

recommendations.text: Produce independent, reproducible evidence for consequential AI decisions.
Bring more global talent into AI safety research quickly.
Test model behaviour and safeguards independently of developers.
